audience: engineering teams that run builds and deploys on a self-hosted Jenkins controller

useCases.title: Find failed builds and read the error
useCases.text: List the recent builds of a job and see which ones failed or were unstable. Open one build and read the end of its console log.

useCases.title: Check the build queue and the agents
useCases.text: See which items wait in the build queue, and why each one waits. Check which build agents are offline or temporarily unavailable.

useCases.title: Review the state of a job
useCases.text: List the top-level jobs or the jobs in one folder. Read the health, last builds and build parameters of one job.

useCases.title: Start a build with parameters
useCases.text: Queue a new build of a job with optional string parameters, such as an environment name. The job runs with its own permissions and can deploy.
